description: Perl script for translating AT&T syntax assembler code from Unix ABI to Windows ABI, supporting dual-ABI OpenSSL modules development, with detailed handling of assembler directives, labels, and Windows SEH unwinding information.

classes.name: opcode
classes.description: Represents an assembler opcode with methods to parse, output, and modify opcode details.

classes.name: const
classes.description: Represents constants in assembler lines, handling parsing and output formatting.

classes.name: ea
classes.description: Represents effective address expressions with parsing and output formatting.

classes.name: register
classes.description: Represents CPU register operands with parsing, size determination, and output formatting.

classes.name: label
classes.description: Represents assembler labels with parsing and output, including special handling for Windows SEH labels.

classes.name: expr
classes.description: Represents assembler expressions with parsing and conditional output formatting.

classes.name: cfi_directive
classes.description: Handles DWARF Call Frame Information directives for stack unwinding.

classes.name: seh_directive
classes.description: Handles Windows Structured Exception Handling directives for exception unwinding.

classes.name: directive
classes.description: Handles assembler directives, including section management and symbol attributes.

methods.name: re
methods.description: Parses a line of assembler code into the respective class object.

methods.name: out
methods.description: Outputs the assembler code or directive in the appropriate syntax.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size attribute for opcode or operand.

methods.name: mnemonic
methods.description: Gets or sets the mnemonic name of the opcode.

methods.name: cfa_expression
methods.description: Constructs a DWARF CFA expression from a line.

methods.name: re
methods.description: Parses a line for specific assembler directives or labels.

methods.name: pdata_and_xdata
methods.description: Generates Windows exception handling data sections (.pdata and .xdata).

methods.name: re
methods.description: Parses assembler directives, labels, and section attributes.
